decisions.reason: The award signal puts this geothermal probe above aspiration levels, and as a large firm with slack and strong adjacent capabilities we would continue backing it.
Although evidence after launch is limited, it is an adjacent geothermal offering that uses existing materials and systems know-how, so uncertain results do not yet justify withdrawal.
This surface technology extends the geothermal line and can be supported by the firm's established production and innovation base, so we would retain it while learning about market acceptance.
A fire-protection steel profile system fits closely with the core construction business and likely meets customer needs in a growing market, making continued marketing the likely choice.
The slim steel profile system is close to the established offer and supports customized solutions, so boundedly rational management would keep it unless clearer underperformance appears.
This decorative surface system is somewhat more discretionary than the others, so its drop risk is higher, but the firm's slack and customer-orientation still favor keeping it for now.
